svg.title: AEGIS
svg.desc: AEGIS, an offline edge-AI farming assistant for Smart India Hackathon 2026. Detects crop disease on a Jetson Nano in 117 ms per image with no internet, alongside an ESP32 sensor mast, an advice engine and a Hindi and English app. Trained on 34,677 images; 343 automated tests. Its spraying-rover extension took 2nd place at Ideathon 2026.
